clos.original_description: LO1. Describe the list data structure and its’ different way of implementations. Implement the singly linked list.
clos.enriched_description: Describe list data structures and their implementation approaches, including arrays, singly linked lists, circularly linked lists, and doubly linked lists. Implement singly linked lists while understanding how list representation choices affect data structure operations.

clos.original_description: LO2. Define stack and queue. Describe basic operations and the use of these structures.
clos.enriched_description: Define stacks and queues and describe their basic operations and uses, including stack operations, queues, double-ended queues (deques), and priority queues as fundamental linear data structures.

clos.original_description: LO3. Describe about recursive definitions, algorithms, functions and their implementation and use.
clos.enriched_description: Describe recursive definitions, recursive algorithms, recursive functions, and their implementation and use, including factorial, binary search, file-system examples, recursive algorithm analysis, linear recursion, binary recursion, multiple recursion, recursive algorithm design, and tail-recursion elimination.

clos.original_description: LO4. Explain about general tree, Binary Tree and Binary Search Tree (BST). Implement BST with basic operations.
clos.enriched_description: Explain general trees, binary trees, and binary search trees, and implement BST operations, including tree definitions and properties, tree abstract data types, binary tree properties, tree implementation, traversal algorithms, BST search, insertions and deletions, balanced search trees, AVL.

clos.original_description: LO5. Díscuss about graphs and their application. Implement a graph with some basic operations.
clos.enriched_description: Discuss graphs and their applications, and implement basic graph operations, including graph representations using edge lists, adjacency lists, and adjacency matrices, depth-first and breadth-first traversal, weighted graphs, shortest paths, Dijkstra's algorithm, minimum spanning trees with Prim-Jarnik and Kruskal algorithms.

clos.original_description: LO6 Explain the operation and performance of some basic and advanced sorting alggorithms
clos.enriched_description: Explain the operation and performance of basic and advanced sorting algorithms, including selection sort, insertion sort, bubble sort, quicksort, merge sort, heap sort, bucket sort, radix sort, and comparison of sorting algorithm performance.

clos.original_description: LO7 Explain about hashing and application.
clos.enriched_description: Explain hashing and its applications, including hash tables, hash functions, collision handling, load factors, rehashing, efficiency considerations, and Python hash table implementation.

clos.original_description: LO8 Describe the Text Processing problem and its’ application. Explain the Huffman, LZW and Run-length encoding Algorithms.
clos.enriched_description: Describe text processing problems and their applications, including digitized text, pattern-matching algorithms, brute-force matching, the Knuth-Morris-Pratt algorithm, text compression, Huffman coding, LZW, and run-length encoding.
